style.vernacular: Tropical Polynesian harbour town in a steep green volcanic bay: low concrete-block and clapboard buildings painted white or pastel under red, green or grey corrugated metal roofs, open Samoan fale (oval or rectangular, post-and-beam) and village churches, 1900s naval colonial buildings with wide verandas, and heavy cloud on the ridges.
style.ornament: Open fale with posts and wide eaves; two-storey verandas on naval-era buildings; white churches with towers; blue or red roofs; coconut palms and breadfruit; grassy malae (village green).
